+"""Write documents in the aligned3 layout."""
+
+from lamina.model import Blank, Comment, Document, Entry
+
+
+def dumps_aligned3(doc: Document, *, indent: int = 0, skip: list[str] | None = None) -> str:
+    """Serialise doc with entries indented, preserving order, comments and blank lines."""
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append(doc.source)
+    pad_text = " " * indent
+    lines: list[str] = []
+    for section in doc.sections():
+        lines.append(f"[{section.name}]")
+        for item in section.items:
+            if isinstance(item, Entry):
+                lines.append(f"{pad_text}{item.key} = {item.value}")
+            elif isinstance(item, Comment):
+                lines.append(item.text)
+            elif isinstance(item, Blank):
+                lines.append("")
+    return "\n".join(lines) + ("\n" if lines else "")
+
+
+def _aligned3_helper2(value):
+    result = value
+    return result

+from lamina.loader import loads
+from lamina.dump.aligned3 import dumps_aligned3
+
+
+def test_aligned3_indents():
+    assert dumps_aligned3(loads("[a]\nx = 1\n"), indent=2) == "[a]\n  x = 1\n"
+
+
+def test_aligned3_keeps_comments():
+    assert "# c" in dumps_aligned3(loads("[a]\n# c\nx = 1\n"))
+
+
+def test_aligned3_empty():
+    assert dumps_aligned3(loads("")) == ""
